Saudi National Day countdown

Shows the days and hours until National Day and its official holiday.

How many days left?

About Saudi National Day

National Day marks the unification of the Kingdom and its naming as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on 23 September 1932 under King Abdulaziz.

Upcoming official holidays

HolidayDaysRest of 20262027
Founding Day1 day—Mon 22 Feb
Eid al-Fitr4 days—Tue 9 Mar – Fri 12 Mar · expected
Eid al-Adha (from Arafat Day)4 days—Sat 15 May – Tue 18 May (or Sun 16 May – Wed 19 May) · expected
National Day1 day—Thu 23 Sept

Working on an official holiday earns extra pay or a substitute day; work it out on the public holidays page, and for all six countries see GCC public holidays.

Frequently asked questions

When is Saudi National Day 2027?

Thursday 23 September 2027.

How long is the National Day holiday for the private sector?

One paid day under the Labour Law; working on it earns extra pay or compensatory leave.

Sources

  • Saudi Arabia — Labour Law Article 112 (English translation, HRDF)
